parts.premise: Time matters. More isn’t always better. While there’s no precise “right” amount of homework, roughly 10 minutes per year in school (starting in first grade) is a helpful guide. So, your first grader might spend 10 minutes on homework per night, while 1.5–2.5 hours is considered a good amount for high schoolers.
